title: P03 — 위저 보드가 스스로 지었다는 이름 (US446054)
cover_en: THE PATENT CALLED IT A TOY

beats.ko: 영혼과 대화하는 판, 특허엔 뭐라고 적혀 있을까요?
beats.en: A board that talks to spirits? Read its patent.

beats.ko: 천팔백구십일 년, 미국이 이 판에 특허를 내줍니다.
beats.en: In 1891, America granted it a patent.

beats.ko: 알파벳과 숫자가 적힌 나무판, 그리고 작은 삼각대.
beats.en: A wooden board of letters, and a small pointer.

beats.ko: 손을 살짝 올리면 삼각대가 글자를 짚습니다.
beats.en: Rest your hand; the pointer picks out letters.
"the table will move and point to certain letters."
Who moves it, it never says.
A woman asked the board its name. It spelled Ouija.
The title on the document: "Toy or Game."
The man who got rich was not the inventor.

beats.ko: 공장 도장공이 회사를 넘겨받아 백만장자가 됐죠.
beats.en: A factory painter took over and made a million.
The woman who named it was erased.

beats.ko: 그런데 그날, 그녀 목에는 로켓 목걸이가 있었습니다.
beats.en: But that night, she wore a locket.
The name inside it: the novelist Ouida.
